response.original_title: Isolation and Discomfort; The Lament of Self or The Prologue to Beckoning Demise
response.overview: This experimental feature created out of a small collection of failed short films, does not explore to human condition but the condition of self, and all the loathing and torture that comes with that. Amateur filmmaker beastyos explores the boundaries of patience and herself.  Cut out of roughly 80 minutes of failed and lost footage, the failure is as much part of this piece as the footage present.
response.title: Isolation and Discomfort; The Lament of Self or The Prologue to Beckoning Demise
